notes: S1-FIX5 X7/§12.2 check 1 (decision 2026-11-12 #3): a second, non-signer certificate writes its outer signatureAlgorithm parameters as 04 00 (an empty OCTET STRING). Since X7/M3 every component of SignedData.certificates other than the signer certificate is an open type, judged by its TLV framing only and never handed to a certificate decoder. The receipt is fully re-signed with the test TSA key, so the CMS signature verifies and the container is valid.
